source_campaign: Funnel clone BG-TUR -> BA-TUR (bhturkish.zlatenkluch.eu), BA cover

extra_rules: Bosnian in LATIN script only (ijekavica), with correct letters č ć š ž đ rendered exactly. No Bulgarian/Cyrillic letters may remain anywhere, including tiny labels, icons, screens and book spines.
This is a 3D book mockup. Keep the book shape, angle, lighting, Turkish flag, Istanbul mosque photo, tea glass, baklava, seagull, icons and all colours identical; change only the text.
Front cover title in two lines in the same bold style and colours: 'TURSKI JEZIK' (dark navy) and 'ZA POČETNIKE' (red).
Spine text in the same style: 'TURSKI JEZIK ZA POČETNIKE' and the small subtitle lines translated the same way as on the front.
Do not add any new text, names or logos. Use a short hyphen, never a long dash.
